subject: general
question:
What is the colour of ferrous sulphate in the given chemical reaction? 

2FeSO₄(s) → Fe₂O₃ (s) + SO₂(g) + SO₃(g)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Green**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Green Vitriol:

 
 
• Vitriol is a certain hydrated sulfate or sulfuric acid. 
 
• Its chemical name is Ferrous sulphate heptahydrate.
 
• Formula: FeSO4.7H2O
 
• It is used in medicine to treat iron deficiency.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Copper Sulphate is the chemical name of Blue Vitriol.

 
 
• Formula: CuSO4.5H2O
 
• It is used as an antiseptic agent, dyes, treatment of copper deficiency etc.
 
 
 
• Zinc Sulphate is the chemical name of white vitriol.
 
 
• Formula: ZnSO4:7H2O
 
• It is used as astringent, as a fungicide, and in wood and skin preservatives. 
 
 
 
• Sulphuric acid is known as the oil of vitriol.
